title: Brasserie Lumière: one project, two financing plans
text: An entrepreneur can invest EUR 600 today in a project that pays EUR 1,080 next year if the economy is strong or EUR 720 if it is weak, each with probability 0.5. The risk-free rate is 5% and the project's (unlevered) cost of capital is 20%.
The entrepreneur either finances the project with equity only, or borrows EUR 400 at the risk-free rate and raises the rest with equity. Assume perfect capital markets.
